## Personality

Joshua Pye is a surly and taciturn individual. He is deeply unsociable by nature, preferring solitude and independence above all else.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P24](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0024)_

## History

Joshua Pye was hired by the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) to paint the local town hall green. However, due to a mix-up in color codes, he accidentally painted the building a bright blue instead. Although his blunder initially caused great despair among the society members, public sympathy ultimately turned against Joshua and the rest of the [Pye](../codex/factions.md#pyes) family.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P2](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0002), [v2 IX A Question of Color P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 IX A Question of Color P4](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0004), [v2 IX A Question of Color P5](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0005), [v2 IX A Question of Color P6](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0006), +23 more_
